safety_contract.consensus_rule: three or more systems across at least two independent evidence families

training.warning: Past performance is not a guarantee of future profitability; the holdout is observational and excludes commission/slippage.

systems.name: Benter Model/Market Blend
systems.method: A fitted geometric blend combines the model's independent fundamental probability with the de-vigged public market, then looks for a positive probability overlay.
systems.adaptation: Uses the fields and chronological result history available in this project; it is not Bill Benter's proprietary Hong Kong model.
systems.status_note: Chronological fitting assigned zero extra weight to the independent fundamental probability; the market-only result creates no honest value bet.

systems.name: Bolton–Chapman Conditional Logit
systems.method: A race-normalised conditional logit combines public odds with pre-race model, trip, pace, place, connection and reliability evidence.
systems.adaptation: Coefficients are fitted on this project's own leakage-safe fields, not copied from the original 1986 paper.

picks.race_name: PricedUp Bet Gordon Richards Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
picks.rationale: Conditional logit 44.2% versus 39.5% market: +4.7pp.
picks.caveat: Coefficients are fitted on this project's own leakage-safe fields, not copied from the original 1986 paper.

systems.name: Dr Z Place Overlay
systems.method: Compares the simulated model chance of making the paid places with the market's place probability and keeps only a material positive overlay.
systems.adaptation: Applies the Dr Z place/show inefficiency idea to bookmaker and exchange top-finish data rather than a US tote place pool.

picks.rationale: Model makes the runner 82.1% for Top 4, a +29.7pp overlay to the place market.
picks.caveat: Applies the Dr Z place/show inefficiency idea to bookmaker and exchange top-finish data rather than a US tote place pool.

systems.name: Quirin Pace-Pressure Proxy
systems.method: Ranks runners by leader profile, ordinal position, pace-setup fit and previous-run reliability, adjusted for the expected pressure in the race.
systems.adaptation: No call-position chart is available, so this is a pace proxy rather than the exact Quirin eight-point speed-point method.

picks.caveat: No call-position chart is available, so this is a pace proxy rather than the exact Quirin eight-point speed-point method.

systems.name: Ragozin-Style Form Cycle
systems.method: Looks for a sound recent form cycle using finishing-percentile trend, recency, trip fit and previous-run reliability while penalising an obvious regression.
systems.adaptation: This is a form-cycle proxy, not a Ragozin Sheet figure; exact times, wind, path/ground loss and weight figure construction are unavailable.

systems.name: Van der Wheil Form/Class
systems.method: Combines recent consistency, wins/places, class evidence, official rating, model rank and position in the betting forecast.
systems.adaptation: Prize-money ability ratings are not consistently available, so class score, official rating and model merit are used as transparent substitutes.
